blocks.zh: Annex I: Quality Risk Management Methods and Tools｜附錄一：品質風險管理方法與工具
blocks.en: Annex I: Quality Risk Management Methods and Tools

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 ICH Q9(R1) Annex I 所列舉的九種 QRM 工具，了解各工具的定義、原理與適用情境
blocks.en: Master the nine QRM tools listed in ICH Q9(R1) Annex I, and understand the definition, principle and typical use of each

blocks.zh: 能夠比較 FMEA / FMECA / FTA / HACCP / HAZOP / PHA 的差異，並在實際情境中選擇正確工具
blocks.en: Be able to compare FMEA / FMECA / FTA / HACCP / HAZOP / PHA and choose the right tool for a real situation

blocks.zh: 理解 FMEA 的 RPN 計算邏輯（Probability × Severity × Detectability）及其在製程驗證中的應用
blocks.en: Understand the RPN calculation logic of FMEA (Probability × Severity × Detectability) and its use in process validation

blocks.zh: 了解 HACCP 七步驟，以及 CCP（關鍵控制點）在無菌製造中的具體意義
blocks.en: Understand the seven HACCP steps and what a CCP (critical control point) means in sterile manufacturing

blocks.zh: 理解 FTA 的邏輯閘（AND/OR gates）如何用於 OOS 偏差根本原因分析
blocks.en: Understand how FTA logic gates (AND/OR gates) are used in root cause analysis of OOS deviations

blocks.zh: 能夠運用「工具選擇決策矩陣」，依據問題類型、時間點與資訊完整度選出最適工具
blocks.en: Be able to use the "tool selection decision matrix" to pick the most suitable tool based on problem type, timing and completeness of information

blocks.zh: Annex I Introduction｜附錄一導言
blocks.en: Annex I Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 沒有萬能工具："no one tool or set of tools is applicable to every situation"——這句話提醒我們，工具選擇需要依據情境判斷，而非套公式。
blocks.en: There is no universal tool: "no one tool or set of tools is applicable to every situation". This is a reminder that tool selection must be based on judgment of the situation, not on applying a formula.

blocks.zh: 形式主義不是必須的：Q9(R1) 明確指出，非正式工具（如 flowchart、check sheet）同樣可被接受。對小型 CDMO 或早期開發階段，不一定要做完整的 FMEA。
blocks.en: Formality is not mandatory: Q9(R1) states clearly that informal tools (such as flowcharts and check sheets) are also acceptable. For a small CDMO or an early development stage, a full FMEA is not always necessary.

blocks.zh: 工具選擇的三個維度：① 時間點（開發前期 vs. 商業化後）；② 資訊完整度（資訊少用 PHA，資訊多用 FMEA/HACCP）；③ 問題方向（找原因用 FTA；找預防措施用 FMEA/HACCP）。
blocks.en: Three dimensions of tool selection: (1) timing (early development vs. post-commercialization); (2) completeness of information (little information: use PHA; more information: use FMEA/HACCP); (3) direction of the question (finding causes: use FTA; finding preventive measures: use FMEA/HACCP).

blocks.zh: I.1 Basic Risk Management Facilitation Methods｜基本風險管理輔助方法
blocks.en: I.1 Basic Risk Management Facilitation Methods

blocks.zh: 四種基本工具解析
blocks.en: The Four Basic Tools Explained

blocks.zh: 流程圖（Flowchart）：視覺化製程步驟與決策點。無菌充填的流程圖涵蓋「原料進廠 → 配製 → 過濾 → 充填 → 凍乾 → 封口 → 目視檢查 → 放行」，每一步驟都是後續 FMEA 分析的單位。
blocks.en: Flowchart: visualizes process steps and decision points. A sterile filling flowchart covers "raw material receipt -> compounding -> filtration -> filling -> lyophilization -> sealing -> visual inspection -> release", and each step becomes a unit of analysis in the subsequent FMEA.

blocks.zh: 查核表（Check Sheet）：結構化數據收集表單。例如環境監測查核表（記錄 EM 採樣結果）或 Autoclave 滅菌記錄查核表。
blocks.en: Check Sheet: a structured data collection form. Examples are an environmental monitoring check sheet (recording EM sampling results) or an autoclave sterilization record check sheet.

blocks.zh: 製程圖（Process Mapping）：比流程圖更詳細，呈現物料流、資訊流與人員流，適合用於 HACCP 分析前的製程理解建立。
blocks.en: Process Mapping: more detailed than a flowchart, showing material flow, information flow and personnel flow; suited to building process understanding before a HACCP analysis.

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖（Ishikawa / Cause-and-Effect Diagram）：以問題（效果）為「魚頭」，向左延伸六大類原因：人（Man）、機（Machine）、料（Material）、法（Method）、環（Environment）、測（Measurement）。常用於偏差調查的初步原因分類。
blocks.en: Ishikawa (Cause-and-Effect) Diagram: the problem (effect) is the "fish head", and six categories of causes extend to the left: Man, Machine, Material, Method, Environment and Measurement. It is commonly used for the initial classification of causes in a deviation investigation.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application in a CDMO

blocks.zh: 在技術轉移初期，CDMO 會先與客戶一起建立完整的製程圖（Process Map）——這是所有後續 QRM 分析的基礎。若缺乏完整製程圖，FMEA 或 HACCP 的分析將是片段且不可靠的。魚骨圖則常出現在 CAPA 文件中，作為偏差根本原因分類的第一步，幫助調查團隊不遺漏任何類別的原因。
blocks.en: At the start of a technology transfer, the CDMO first builds a complete Process Map together with the client. This is the basis for all later QRM analyses; without a complete process map, an FMEA or HACCP analysis will be fragmentary and unreliable. Fishbone diagrams often appear in CAPA documents as the first step in classifying deviation root causes, helping the investigation team avoid missing any category of cause.

blocks.zh: I.2 Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA)｜故障模式影響分析
blocks.en: I.2 Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA)

blocks.zh: FMEA vs. FMECA 的差別
blocks.en: FMEA vs. FMECA

blocks.zh: FMEA：評估故障模式及其影響，輸出 RPN。
blocks.en: FMEA: evaluates failure modes and their effects, and outputs an RPN.

blocks.zh: FMECA（I.3）：在 FMEA 基礎上，加入「Criticality Analysis」——把 P × S 的組合畫在「Criticality Matrix」上，明確區分哪些故障屬於「關鍵風險」。FMECA 更適合用於安全關鍵系統（如注射用藥）。
blocks.en: FMECA (I.3): adds a "Criticality Analysis" on top of FMEA. The P × S combination is plotted on a "Criticality Matrix" to clearly distinguish which failures are "critical risks". FMECA is better suited to safety-critical systems (such as injectable drugs).

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 為客戶導入一條新的充填線時，設備確效（Equipment Qualification）前必須完成 FMEA。常見做法是在 DQ（設計確效）階段完成初版 FMEA，在 IQ/OQ 後更新，PQ 後最終版歸檔。FMEA 也是 FDA PAI（Pre-Approval Inspection）的重點審查文件——查驗員會詢問：「你們如何識別充填製程的關鍵風險？」有 FMEA 文件支撐的回答遠比口頭說明有力。
blocks.en: When a CDMO introduces a new filling line for a client, an FMEA must be completed before equipment qualification. A common approach is to complete the first version of the FMEA at the DQ (design qualification) stage, update it after IQ/OQ, and file the final version after PQ. The FMEA is also a key document reviewed in an FDA PAI (Pre-Approval Inspection): the inspector will ask, "How did you identify the critical risks of the filling process?" An answer backed by an FMEA document is far stronger than a verbal explanation.

blocks.zh: FMEA 核心公式：RPN（Risk Priority Number）
blocks.en: FMEA Core Formula: RPN (Risk Priority Number)

blocks.zh: RPN 越高 = 優先處理。一般以 RPN ≥ 100 或 S ≥ 8 作為必須採取 CAPA 的閾值（各公司標準不同）。
blocks.en: The higher the RPN, the higher the priority. A common practice is to use RPN ≥ 100 or S ≥ 8 as the threshold that requires CAPA (company standards differ).

blocks.zh: 注意：D 分數反直覺——越容易偵測到，D 分數越低（越好）。
blocks.en: Note: the D score is counterintuitive. The easier a failure is to detect, the lower (better) the D score.

blocks.zh: FMEA 無菌充填應用範例
blocks.en: FMEA Example for Sterile Filling

blocks.zh: RPN=200 的「操作員干擾充填路徑」需優先採取 CAPA：可透過自動化、強化 gowning 訓練或重新設計設備布局解決。
blocks.en: The "operator interferes with the filling path" failure mode, with RPN = 200, needs CAPA first: it can be addressed through automation, stronger gowning training, or redesign of the equipment layout.

blocks.zh: I.3 Failure Mode, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA)｜故障模式影響與關鍵性分析
blocks.en: I.3 Failure Mode, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA)

blocks.zh: 何時選 FMEA，何時選 FMECA？
blocks.en: When to Choose FMEA and When to Choose FMECA

blocks.zh: 使用 FMEA：一般製程風險評估、設備確效、變更管控——當需要快速產出 RPN 排序清單時。
blocks.en: Use FMEA: for general process risk assessment, equipment qualification and change control, when a ranked RPN list is needed quickly.

blocks.zh: 使用 FMECA：涉及患者安全的關鍵製程（如注射用藥無菌充填、高活性 API）、或當法規機關要求更嚴格的風險文件（FDA CGMP 483 回覆）時。FMECA 提供更完整的「關鍵性」論證。
blocks.en: Use FMECA: for critical processes that affect patient safety (such as sterile filling of injectables or highly potent APIs), or when a regulator requires more rigorous risk documentation (for example, a response to an FDA CGMP Form 483). FMECA provides a fuller justification of "criticality".

blocks.zh: FMECA 的關鍵延伸：Criticality Matrix
blocks.en: The Key Extension of FMECA: the Criticality Matrix

blocks.zh: FMECA 在 FMEA 的基礎上，特別強調「關鍵性（Criticality）」的視覺化分析。除了計算 RPN 數值，FMECA 還將故障模式繪製在 Criticality Matrix（關鍵性矩陣）上：
blocks.en: FMECA builds on FMEA and places particular emphasis on visual analysis of "criticality". In addition to calculating the RPN, FMECA plots failure modes on a Criticality Matrix:

blocks.zh: 落在右上角（極高風險）的故障模式即為「Critical Failure Modes」，需要立即採取預防措施，無論 D（可偵測性）分數如何。
blocks.en: Failure modes that fall in the upper right corner (extremely high risk) are "Critical Failure Modes" and require immediate preventive action, regardless of the D (detectability) score.

blocks.zh: I.4 Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)｜故障樹分析
blocks.en: I.4 Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)

blocks.zh: FTA 實例：OOS 結果調查
blocks.en: FTA Example: Investigating an OOS Result

blocks.zh: 頂層事件（Top Event）：批次無菌測試陽性（Sterility Test Failure）
blocks.en: Top Event: batch sterility test positive (Sterility Test Failure)

blocks.zh:
批次無菌測試陽性
        │ OR gate
   ┌────┴────┐
製程污染   實驗室污染
   │ OR        │ OR
 ┌─┴─┐      ┌─┴─┐
過濾  充填  培養基 操作員
失效  污染  問題   技術

過濾失效
   │ AND gate（需同時）
 ┌─┴────┐
濾膜缺陷 + 完整性測試未執行
blocks.en:
Batch sterility test positive
        │ OR gate
   ┌────┴────┐
Process      Laboratory
contamination contamination
   │ OR        │ OR
 ┌─┴─┐      ┌─┴─┐
Filtration  Filling  Culture  Analyst
failure  contamination  media issue  technique

Filtration failure
   │ AND gate (both required)
 ┌─┴────┐
Filter defect + Integrity test not performed

blocks.zh: AND gate 告訴我們：只要確保「充填後完整性測試 100% 執行」，即使有濾膜缺陷也能被攔截。這就是為什麼 SOP 要求除菌過濾後必須做完整性測試。
blocks.en: The AND gate tells us that as long as "post-filtration integrity testing is performed 100% of the time", a filter defect will still be caught. This is why SOPs require an integrity test after sterilizing filtration.

blocks.zh: FTA vs. FMEA：方向相反的互補工具
blocks.en: FTA vs. FMEA: Complementary Tools Working in Opposite Directions

blocks.zh: FMEA（由下而上，歸納法）：從已知的故障模式出發，問「這個故障會造成什麼影響？」——預防導向，用於設計階段。
blocks.en: FMEA (bottom-up, inductive): starts from known failure modes and asks "What effect will this failure cause?" It is prevention-oriented and used at the design stage.

blocks.zh: FTA（由上而下，演繹法）：從已發生的不良事件出發，問「是什麼原因導致了這個結果？」——調查導向，用於偏差/OOS 分析。
blocks.en: FTA (top-down, deductive): starts from an adverse event that has occurred and asks "What caused this result?" It is investigation-oriented and used for deviation/OOS analysis.

blocks.zh: 最佳實務：先用 FMEA 預防，事件發生後用 FTA 調查，兩者互補而非替代。
blocks.en: Best practice: use FMEA first for prevention, and use FTA to investigate after an event occurs. The two complement each other rather than replace each other.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在收到客戶的 OOS 通知後，Deviation 調查報告中常以 FTA 呈現根本原因分析路徑。FDA 查驗員對 FTA 的接受度很高，因為它能清楚呈現調查的邏輯性與完整性。一份完整的 FTA 應包含：① 頂層事件定義、② 所有可能原因的系統性展開、③ 每個分支的調查證據、④ 最終確認的根本原因（以 "Confirmed Root Cause" 標示）。
blocks.en: After receiving an OOS notification from a client, a CDMO often presents the root cause analysis path as an FTA in the deviation investigation report. FDA inspectors readily accept FTA because it clearly shows the logic and completeness of the investigation. A complete FTA should contain: (1) a definition of the top event, (2) a systematic expansion of all possible causes, (3) investigation evidence for each branch, and (4) the finally confirmed root cause (marked "Confirmed Root Cause").

blocks.zh: FTA 邏輯閘解析：AND gate vs. OR gate
blocks.en: FTA Logic Gates: AND gate vs. OR gate

blocks.zh: FTA 使用「邏輯閘」（Logic Gates）來描述多個原因如何組合導致失敗：
blocks.en: FTA uses "logic gates" to describe how multiple causes combine to lead to a failure:

blocks.zh: 實務洞察：OR gate 代表的失敗路徑風險更高（更難防範）；AND gate 代表的失敗需要「完美風暴」才會發生，但一旦發生通常更嚴重。
blocks.en: Practical insight: an OR gate represents a failure path with higher risk (harder to guard against); an AND gate represents a failure that needs a "perfect storm" to occur, but when it does occur it is usually more serious.

blocks.zh: I.5 Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP)｜危害分析與關鍵控制點
blocks.en: I.5 Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP)

blocks.zh: HACCP 的食品工業起源
blocks.en: The Food Industry Origins of HACCP

blocks.zh: HACCP 最早由 NASA 在 1960 年代為太空人食品安全而開發，後來成為全球食品工業強制標準（Codex Alimentarius）。製藥業借用此概念，特別適用於無菌製造。一個關鍵差異：食品業的 CCP 多為物理/化學危害（如加熱殺菌溫度）；製藥業的 CCP 除微生物控制外，還需考慮 交叉污染（cross-contamination）和 混淆（mix-up）危害——這是藥品獨有的安全風險。
blocks.en: HACCP was first developed by NASA in the 1960s for astronaut food safety and later became the mandatory standard of the global food industry (Codex Alimentarius). The pharmaceutical industry borrowed the concept, and it is particularly suited to sterile manufacturing. One key difference: in the food industry, CCPs are mostly physical/chemical hazards (such as heat sterilization temperature); in pharmaceuticals, besides microbial control, cross-contamination and mix-up hazards must also be considered. These are safety risks unique to medicinal products.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的無菌充填部門而言，HACCP 計畫應成為 Site Master File 的一部分。當 CDMO 接受 EU QP 審核或 FDA PAI 時，HACCP 文件是展示「系統性危害控制」的最有力證據。建議每 1–2 年或發生重大偏差後進行 HACCP 計畫再評估，確保 CCP 清單反映最新製程狀態。
blocks.en: For the sterile filling department of a CDMO, the HACCP plan should be part of the Site Master File. When the CDMO undergoes an EU QP audit or an FDA PAI, the HACCP document is the strongest evidence of "systematic hazard control". It is recommended to re-evaluate the HACCP plan every 1-2 years or after a major deviation, to ensure the CCP list reflects the latest state of the process.

blocks.zh: CCP vs. CP vs. OP：三種控制點的差別
blocks.en: CCP vs. CP vs. OP: The Differences Between the Three Types of Control Points

blocks.zh: CCP 的識別是 HACCP 最關鍵的一步。識別標準：① 此步驟是否能消除或降低危害至可接受水準？② 後續是否有補救步驟？若無補救，則為 CCP。
blocks.en: Identifying CCPs is the most critical step in HACCP. The criteria are: (1) Can this step eliminate the hazard or reduce it to an acceptable level? (2) Is there a later step that can remedy it? If there is no remedy, it is a CCP.

blocks.zh: I.6 Hazard Operability Analysis (HAZOP)｜危害與可操作性分析
blocks.en: I.6 Hazard Operability Analysis (HAZOP)

blocks.zh: HAZOP 的優缺點
blocks.en: Strengths and Weaknesses of HAZOP

blocks.zh: 優點：系統性強、不易遺漏盲點；由跨職能團隊執行，集合多領域知識；對設備/設施設計審查特別有效。
blocks.en: Strengths: highly systematic and unlikely to leave blind spots; performed by a cross-functional team that brings together knowledge from several fields; particularly effective for equipment/facility design review.

blocks.zh: 缺點：非常耗時——一個複雜製程的 HAZOP 可能需要 2–5 天的專家會議；需要設計圖紙（P&ID）和詳細製程文件；不適合在資訊很少的早期開發階段使用（此時用 PHA 更合適）。
blocks.en: Weaknesses: very time-consuming (a HAZOP of a complex process may need 2-5 days of expert meetings); requires design drawings (P&ID) and detailed process documents; not suitable for early development stages where little information is available (PHA is more appropriate then).

blocks.zh: 適用時機：新廠房設計、新設備引入、重大製程變更的設計審查（Design Review）。
blocks.en: When to use: design review (Design Review) of new facility design, introduction of new equipment, and major process changes.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在新廠房建設或舊廠翻新時，應在詳細設計（Detail Design）完成後、施工開始前執行 HAZOP。參與者應包括：製程工程師、設備工程師、QA、安全人員、生產操作員代表。HAZOP 的行動項目（Action Items）應追蹤至關閉，並作為 DQ（設計確效）的輸入文件。一個常見的 HAZOP 發現：「More pressure on filtration manifold」可能導致濾膜破裂——解決方案是加裝壓力安全閥（pressure relief valve）並設定上限報警。
blocks.en: When building a new facility or renovating an old one, a CDMO should run the HAZOP after Detail Design is complete and before construction starts. Participants should include process engineers, equipment engineers, QA, safety staff and a production operator representative. HAZOP action items should be tracked to closure and used as an input document to DQ (design qualification). A common HAZOP finding: "More pressure on filtration manifold" may cause the filter to rupture. The solution is to install a pressure relief valve and set an upper-limit alarm.

blocks.zh: HAZOP 引導詞（Guide Words）完整解析
blocks.en: HAZOP Guide Words Explained

blocks.zh: HAZOP 的核心是將標準引導詞與製程參數系統性組合，生成「假設情境」（What-if scenarios）：
blocks.en: The core of HAZOP is to systematically combine standard guide words with process parameters to generate "what-if scenarios":

blocks.zh: I.7 Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA)｜初步危害分析
blocks.en: I.7 Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA)

blocks.zh: PHA：早期篩查，為深入分析鋪路
blocks.en: PHA: Early Screening That Paves the Way for Deeper Analysis

blocks.zh: PHA 是最「輕量」的正式 QRM 工具，特別適合在以下情境使用：
blocks.en: PHA is the "lightest" formal QRM tool and is particularly suitable in the following situations:

blocks.zh: 新藥品開發初期（Phase 1 前），只有藥物作用機制和初步配方概念
blocks.en: Early in new drug development (before Phase 1), when only the mechanism of action and a preliminary formulation concept exist

blocks.zh: 廠房選址評估，只有地點和初步設計概念
blocks.en: Site selection assessment, when only the location and a preliminary design concept exist

blocks.zh: 評估一個全新的製程技術（如連續製造）引入的潛在危害
blocks.en: Assessing the potential hazards introduced by a completely new process technology (such as continuous manufacturing)

blocks.zh: 快速篩查：將大量潛在危害按嚴重度×機率初步分類，決定哪些值得深入用 FMEA/HACCP 分析
blocks.en: Rapid screening: initially classify a large number of potential hazards by severity × probability, and decide which deserve deeper analysis with FMEA/HACCP

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 評估是否接受一個新產品（如高活性腫瘤藥、mRNA 疫苗）時，PHA 是商業決策的重要工具：評估現有廠房和設備能否安全處理新品種的危害等級，以及需要投入多少改造費用。這個早期 PHA 評估結果直接影響 CDMO 的報價和交貨時程。
blocks.en: When a CDMO evaluates whether to accept a new product (such as a highly potent oncology drug or an mRNA vaccine), PHA is an important tool for the business decision: it assesses whether the existing facility and equipment can safely handle the hazard level of the new product, and how much must be invested in modifications. The result of this early PHA directly affects the CDMO's quotation and delivery timeline.

blocks.zh: PHA 輸出格式範例
blocks.en: PHA Output Format Example

blocks.zh: PHA 的輸出是後續工具的「路線圖」：高等級危害 → 深入 FMEA/HACCP；中等危害 → 標準控制程序；低危害 → 常規監控即可。
blocks.en: The output of a PHA is the "roadmap" for later tools: high-level hazards -> in-depth FMEA/HACCP; medium hazards -> standard control procedures; low hazards -> routine monitoring is enough.

blocks.zh: I.8 Risk Ranking and Filtering｜風險排序與篩選
blocks.en: I.8 Risk Ranking and Filtering

blocks.zh: Risk Ranking and Filtering：跨系統比較的工具
blocks.en: Risk Ranking and Filtering: A Tool for Comparing Across Systems

blocks.zh: FMEA 適合對單一製程的風險進行深入分析；但當管理層需要比較不同產品線、不同廠區、或不同系統之間的相對風險時，就需要 Risk Ranking and Filtering。
blocks.en: FMEA suits in-depth analysis of the risks of a single process; but when management needs to compare the relative risk between different product lines, different sites, or different systems, Risk Ranking and Filtering is needed.

blocks.zh: 運作原理：
blocks.en: How it works:

blocks.zh: 識別所有需比較的風險維度（如：患者傷害潛力、法規合規風險、供應鏈穩定性、財務影響）
blocks.en: Identify all the risk dimensions to be compared (for example: potential for patient harm, regulatory compliance risk, supply chain stability, financial impact)

blocks.zh: 對每個維度設定權重（Weighting Factors）反映其相對重要性
blocks.en: Set a weighting factor for each dimension to reflect its relative importance

blocks.zh: 對每個系統/產品/廠區進行評分
blocks.en: Score each system/product/site

blocks.zh: 計算加權風險分數 → 排序
blocks.en: Calculate the weighted risk score and rank

blocks.zh: 設定「篩選閾值（Filter/Cut-off）」：高於閾值 → 優先投入資源
blocks.en: Set a "filter/cut-off threshold": above the threshold, prioritize resources

blocks.zh: 多產品 CDMO 每年面臨資源分配的挑戰：有限的 QA 人力應優先投入哪些產品線的監控和審查？Risk Ranking 模型可以幫助管理層做出客觀、有文件支撐的資源分配決策，同時也能向客戶展示 CDMO 有系統性的風險管理文化——這是高價值服務的競爭力來源。
blocks.en: A multi-product CDMO faces a resource allocation challenge every year: on which product lines should limited QA staff focus their monitoring and review? A Risk Ranking model helps management make objective, documented resource allocation decisions, and also shows clients that the CDMO has a systematic risk management culture, which is a source of competitiveness for high-value services.

blocks.zh: 應用範例：稽核頻率決策
blocks.en: Application Example: Deciding Audit Frequency

blocks.zh: FDA 和 EMA 都使用 Risk Ranking 決定各廠商的查廠頻率。一個典型的稽核風險評分模型：
blocks.en: Both the FDA and EMA use Risk Ranking to decide how often to inspect each manufacturer. A typical audit risk scoring model:

blocks.zh: 廠商A總分較高 → 優先安排稽核。這正是 FDA 用來決定年度查廠計畫的邏輯。
blocks.en: Supplier A has the higher total score, so it is scheduled for audit first. This is exactly the logic the FDA uses to decide its annual inspection plan.

blocks.zh: I.9 Supporting Statistical Tools｜支援性統計工具
blocks.en: I.9 Supporting Statistical Tools

blocks.zh: 統計工具 ≠ 主要 QRM 工具
blocks.en: Statistical Tools Are Not Primary QRM Tools

blocks.zh: Q9(R1) 將統計工具列為「Supporting（支援性）」工具——它們不能獨立執行完整的風險評估，而是為 FMEA、HACCP 等主要工具提供定量數據支撐。例如：FMEA 評估「機率（P）」分數時，應查閱歷史批次管制圖數據來定量評估故障發生頻率，而不是僅憑主觀判斷。
blocks.en: Q9(R1) lists statistical tools as "Supporting" tools. They cannot carry out a complete risk assessment on their own, but provide quantitative data to support primary tools such as FMEA and HACCP. For example, when scoring "probability (P)" in an FMEA, historical batch control chart data should be consulted to quantify the failure frequency, rather than relying on subjective judgment alone.

blocks.zh: 持續製程驗證（Continued Process Verification, CPV）報告中，統計工具是核心內容：每個 CQA 和 CPP 都應有管制圖追蹤，Cpk 計算顯示製程能力，Pareto 分析揭示主要偏差來源。這份 CPV 報告既是 GMP 要求（FDA 21 CFR 211.180(e)；EU GMP Annex 15），也是年度產品回顧（APR）的統計基礎，更是 FMEA 更新版本的輸入。
blocks.en: In a Continued Process Verification (CPV) report, statistical tools are the core content: every CQA and CPP should be tracked with a control chart, Cpk calculations show process capability, and Pareto analysis reveals the main sources of deviation. This CPV report is both a GMP requirement (FDA 21 CFR 211.180(e); EU GMP Annex 15) and the statistical basis for the Annual Product Review (APR), and it is also an input to updated versions of the FMEA.

blocks.en: Tool Selection Framework

blocks.zh: 情境練習 Scenario-Based Practice
blocks.en: Scenario-Based Practice

blocks.zh: 情境練習題 Practice Scenarios
blocks.en: Practice Scenarios

blocks.zh:
情境一：你的 CDMO 正在為客戶新建一條凍乾機（lyophilizer）充填線。在設備到位、開始 IQ 確效之前，你想系統性地識別這條充填線可能的操作危害（如溫度偏差、門密封失效、冷凝水污染）。你應該使用哪個 QRM 工具？為什麼不適合用 FTA？
參考答案：HAZOP——因為有設計圖（P&ID），適合引導詞腦力激盪；FTA 是事後調查工具，事前預防應用有限。
blocks.en:
Scenario 1: Your CDMO is building a new lyophilizer (freeze dryer) filling line for a client. Before the equipment arrives and IQ qualification starts, you want to systematically identify possible operating hazards of this filling line (such as temperature excursions, door seal failure and condensate contamination). Which QRM tool should you use? Why is FTA not suitable?
Reference answer: HAZOP. Design drawings (P&ID) exist, which suits guide-word brainstorming; FTA is a retrospective investigation tool and has limited use for upfront prevention.

blocks.zh:
情境二：批次放行前，你收到環境監測（EM）報告，A 級區浮游菌監測結果超出警戒值（Alert Level）。你需要進行偏差調查，找出污染來源。你應選擇哪個工具？你的「頂層事件（Top Event）」應如何定義？
參考答案：FTA——頂層事件定義為「A 級區浮游菌超出警戒值」，往下展開 OR gate：操作員污染 | 環境系統異常 | 設備表面污染 | 培養基問題。
blocks.en:
Scenario 2: Before batch release, you receive an environmental monitoring (EM) report in which the grade A viable air monitoring result exceeds the Alert Level. You need to run a deviation investigation to find the source of contamination. Which tool should you choose? How should your "Top Event" be defined?
Reference answer: FTA. Define the top event as "grade A viable air count exceeds the alert level", then expand downward through an OR gate: operator contamination | environmental system abnormality | equipment surface contamination | culture media issue.

blocks.zh:
情境三：你的公司計劃新增一個無菌凍乾注射劑產品線。這是一個新劑型，你的 QA 主管要求在 Phase 2 臨床試驗製造前完成初步風險評估，但此時製程細節尚未確定。你應選擇哪個工具？輸出應包含哪些內容？
參考答案：PHA——輸出應包括危害類型清單（微生物、化學、物理、交叉污染）、每類危害的初步嚴重度與機率等級、危害等級排序（高/中/低）、以及後續深入分析建議（哪些危害需要 FMEA/HACCP）。
blocks.en:
Scenario 3: Your company plans to add a sterile lyophilized injectable product line. It is a new dosage form, and your QA head requires a preliminary risk assessment before Phase 2 clinical trial manufacturing, but the process details are not yet fixed. Which tool should you choose? What should the output contain?
Reference answer: PHA. The output should include a list of hazard types (microbial, chemical, physical, cross-contamination), a preliminary severity and probability level for each type of hazard, a ranking of hazard levels (high/medium/low), and recommendations for further analysis (which hazards need FMEA/HACCP).

blocks.zh:
情境四：你負責管理一個擁有 5 個充填線的 CDMO 廠，需要決定今年 QA 資源（僅夠深入審查 2 條充填線）優先投入哪兩條。每條充填線的產品類型、歷史偏差頻率和客戶重要性都不同。應選用哪個 QRM 工具？
參考答案：Risk Ranking and Filtering——建立加權評分矩陣，維度包括：產品類型（無菌注射 vs. 口服）、過去 12 個月 OOS 頻率、客戶合約金額、上次 QA 深度審查距今時間。
blocks.en:
Scenario 4: You manage a CDMO site with 5 filling lines and must decide where to focus this year's QA resources (enough to deeply review only 2 filling lines). Each filling line differs in product type, historical deviation frequency and client importance. Which QRM tool should you use?
Reference answer: Risk Ranking and Filtering. Build a weighted scoring matrix with dimensions such as product type (sterile injectable vs. oral), OOS frequency over the past 12 months, client contract value, and time since the last in-depth QA review.

blocks.zh:
情境五：凍乾機的 Shelf Temperature 控制 SOP 的操作範圍是 -40°C 到 +30°C。你懷疑凍乾機在某些批次中可能造成無菌保證失敗。在做 FMEA 評估 Shelf Temperature 這個製程步驟時，如何評定 RPN？哪個維度（P/S/D）最影響此故障模式的優先級？
參考答案：S（嚴重度）最高（=10，患者安全）；D 需評估是否有完整的溫度記錄和圖表監控——若有 PI 記錄儀（Programmer/Controller）自動報警，D 分數低（好）；P 視歷史故障記錄而定。若 S=10、D=2、P=2，RPN=40，但因 S=10 仍應優先處理（不能單靠 RPN 判斷）。
blocks.en:
Scenario 5: The operating range in the lyophilizer Shelf Temperature control SOP is -40°C to +30°C. You suspect that in some batches the lyophilizer may have caused a failure of sterility assurance. When using FMEA to assess the Shelf Temperature process step, how do you rate the RPN? Which dimension (P/S/D) most affects the priority of this failure mode?
Reference answer: S (severity) is highest (= 10, patient safety). For D, assess whether complete temperature records and trend monitoring exist; if a PI recorder (programmer/controller) raises automatic alarms, the D score is low (good). P depends on historical failure records. If S=10, D=2 and P=2, the RPN is 40, but because S=10 it should still be handled first (the decision cannot rest on RPN alone).

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary — Annex I: QRM Methods and Tools
blocks.en: Section Summary - Annex I: QRM Methods and Tools

blocks.zh: 九種工具各有定位：沒有萬能工具，需依據「問題方向（預防 vs. 調查）」、「時間點（設計前 vs. 商業化後）」、「資訊完整度」三個維度選擇最適工具。
blocks.en: Each of the nine tools has its own role: there is no universal tool; choose the most suitable one on three dimensions: "direction of the question (prevention vs. investigation)", "timing (before design vs. after commercialization)" and "completeness of information".

blocks.zh: FMEA / FMECA：歸納法，由製程步驟出發評估故障模式；RPN = P × S × D；FMECA 加入 Criticality Matrix，更適合患者安全關鍵製程。
blocks.en: FMEA / FMECA: inductive; starts from process steps to assess failure modes; RPN = P × S × D; FMECA adds a Criticality Matrix and is better suited to patient-safety-critical processes.

blocks.zh: FTA：演繹法，由頂層事件（已發生的失敗）出發，使用 AND/OR 邏輯閘追溯根本原因；是 OOS 和偏差調查的最佳工具。
blocks.en: FTA: deductive; starts from the top event (a failure that has occurred) and traces root causes using AND/OR logic gates; the best tool for OOS and deviation investigation.

blocks.zh: HACCP：系統性七步驟架構，識別 CCP 並建立監控機制；CCP 是製程中失控後無補救的關鍵點，需 100% 監控。適合無菌製造全製程管控。
blocks.en: HACCP: a systematic seven-step framework that identifies CCPs and sets up monitoring; a CCP is a point in the process where, once control is lost, there is no remedy, and it needs 100% monitoring. Suited to control of the entire sterile manufacturing process.

blocks.zh: HAZOP：引導詞（No/More/Less/Reverse 等）應用於製程參數，系統性識別設計偏差風險；最適合新廠/新設備設計審查，但耗時。
blocks.en: HAZOP: applies guide words (No/More/Less/Reverse, etc.) to process parameters to systematically identify design deviation risks; best for new facility/new equipment design review, but time-consuming.

blocks.zh: PHA：資訊有限時的早期篩查工具，用先驗知識識別危害等級，產出後續深入分析的路線圖；最常用於開發初期和新產品評估。
blocks.en: PHA: an early screening tool when information is limited; uses prior knowledge to identify hazard levels and produces a roadmap for deeper analysis; most often used in early development and new product evaluation.

blocks.zh: Risk Ranking and Filtering：跨系統/廠區/產品的比較排序工具；使用加權評分和篩選閾值，為管理層資源分配提供客觀依據。
blocks.en: Risk Ranking and Filtering: a tool for comparing and ranking across systems/sites/products; uses weighted scoring and a filter threshold to give management an objective basis for resource allocation.

blocks.zh: 統計工具（Control Charts, DOE, Pareto, Cpk）：支援性工具，為主要 QRM 工具提供定量數據；管制圖和製程能力分析是 CPV 的核心，也是持續更新 FMEA 的輸入。
blocks.en: Statistical tools (Control Charts, DOE, Pareto, Cpk): supporting tools that give the primary QRM tools quantitative data; control charts and process capability analysis are the core of CPV and an input for continually updating the FMEA.
